annotations.title: Restart needed to finish updates
annotations.summary: Security updates were installed but only take effect after a restart.
annotations.impact: The server keeps running fine, but the new protections are not active yet.
annotations.action: Observers restart themselves at 04:00 UTC. For production servers, pick a quiet moment to reboot.
